title: Prediction of Hit-to-Lead Ligand Molecule Interaction with G-Quadruplex DNA from c-Myc Oncogene Promoter Region.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子对接预测小分子配体与c-Myc启动子G-四链体DNA的相互作用，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（配体-DNA）且方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测，但对象非TF-DNA体系且无AI/物理模拟深度建模。
abstract: Targeting guanine (G)-rich DNA sequences, folded into non-canonical G-quadruplex (G4) structures, by small ligand molecules is a potential strategy for gene therapy of cancer disease. BRACO-19 has been recently established as a unique (thermodynamically favorable and highly selective) binder, being involved in the external stacking mode of interaction with a G4-DNA formed in the c-Myc oncogene promoter region (P. M. Mitrasinovic, Croat. Chem. Acta 2019, 92, 43-57). Herein, hit-to-lead ligands are identified using high-throughput virtual screening (HTVS). Search of the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) databases is performed using the key pharmacophore features of BRACO-19. At the very outset, out of a total of 29,009 entries, 95 hits are extracted and evaluated by docking them in the binding sites of G4. Then, 22 hits are chosen by observing the binding free energies. Consequently, 3 hit-to-lead candidates are selected on the basis of structural criteria. Finally, a lead candidate structure is proposed using analog design and considering both the physicochemical requirements for optimal biological activity and a variety of pharmacological standpoints. Implications of the present study for experimental research are discussed.
abstract_zh: 靶向富含鸟嘌呤（G）的DNA序列，折叠成非经典G-四链体（G4）结构，通过小配体分子是癌症疾病基因治疗的一种潜在策略。BRACO-19最近被确立为一种独特的（热力学有利且高度选择性）结合剂，参与与c-Myc癌基因启动子区域形成的G4-DNA的外部堆叠模式相互作用（P. M. Mitrasinovic, Croat. Chem. Acta 2019, 92, 43-57）。在此，通过高通量虚拟筛选（HTVS）识别出从命中到先导的配体。使用BRACO-19的关键药效团特征对京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）数据库进行搜索。最初，从总共29,009个条目中提取出95个命中，并通过将它们对接至G4的结合位点进行评估。随后，通过观察结合自由能选择出22个命中。接着，基于结构标准选出3个命中到先导的候选物。最后，通过类似物设计，并考虑最佳生物活性的物理化学要求及多种药理学观点，提出一个先导候选结构。本研究对实验研究的意义进行了讨论。
